name: audio-device-selector
title: Audio Device Selector
description: Interactively switch and manage macOS audio devices via the audio-device-monitor binary.
author: howard

commands.name: switch-output
commands.title: Switch Output Device
commands.subtitle: Audio Device Selector
commands.description: Pick an output device to make it the default output.

commands.name: switch-input
commands.title: Switch Input Device
commands.subtitle: Audio Device Selector
commands.description: Pick an input device to make it the default input.

commands.name: show-current
commands.title: Show Current Devices
commands.subtitle: Audio Device Selector
commands.description: Show the current default output and input devices.

commands.name: apply-preferences
commands.title: Apply Preferences
commands.subtitle: Audio Device Selector
commands.description: Switch to your configured priority devices.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Audio Devices Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Audio Device Selector
commands.description: Show the current input device in the macOS menu bar with quick-switch for input and output. Enable/disable it from the command settings.

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: Binary Path
preferences.description: Path to the audio-device-monitor binary. Use a bare name to resolve it from PATH, or an absolute path.
